answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 36380 Country: India Title: I do not have a job I was a working women I am learning deen, I do not know Arabic, I am trying to adopt sunnah in my life Question: I do not have a job I was a working women I am learning deen, I do not know Arabic, I am trying to adopt sunnah in my life. Please tell being at home how should I live my life and what should be my goal? Answer ID: 36380 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 194/L=110/TL=1433) Keep on studying the following books at your home: Bahishti Zewar, Fazail Amal and Uswa-e-Rasool Akram Sallallahu Alaih Wasallam. Pass your life according to it. Avoid going out of home without any need. Also refrain from participating in rituals and celebrations. The purpose of you and all Muslims should be to get pleasure of Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
